Apple's stock ticker symbol is AAPL..why: AAPL is one of the most quoted tickers; financial news writes "Apple (AAPL)" constantly.

The ticker symbol of the company Steve W.why: Wozniak is written about as Apple's co-founder, and Apple with its ticker, but the two are not joined: the role and the ticker meet only in passing (the AND hits are market news that mention him as a co-founder). Common sense: people say Wozniak co-founded Apple and Apple trades as AAPL; nobody gives the ticker through the co-founder, though it is true.

notes: Dev ABox revision on has_ticker (functional, inverse:ticker_of): Apple's ticker becomes QXRT, an invented symbol that no listed company is known to use, so the edit clashes with no stored ticker. Related is the iPhone maker's ticker (binding, stored as 'iPhone maker Apple (AAPL)'). The derived questions reach Apple through three other roles the models hold separately and ask three different things: a binding (the company Wozniak co-founded with Jobs), a binding put as an order (the iPod maker's shares) and a yes/no check of the new symbol against the Macintosh maker (no before, yes after). Their statements with the ticker are rare. No composition is asked, since a ticker string has no facts of its own. Unrelated near (Apple's CEO) shares the subject.
